entities.title: The stat key has no ctime
entities.summary: A rewrite that keeps size, modification time and birth time is not detected from the stat key.
entities.impact: Such a file keeps its old analysis until its stat key changes.
entities.details: Listed in the README's Known limits (ctime is not exposed by .NET), which says the watcher still catches such a rewrite. In the code a watcher event leads to RootIndex.Analyze, which also returns early when FileEntry.Matches holds, so the watcher does not catch it either; see backlog.json, watcher-same-stat-key.

entities.title: No replay outside macOS
entities.summary: Linux (and any non-macOS system) uses FileSystemWatcher, which cannot replay, so every start runs a full reconcile.
entities.impact: Startup on Linux re-stats every file of every root.
entities.details: Listed in the README's Known limits, which also says FSEvents replay is covered by a macOS-only test in CI but was not run on a Mac when written, and that Windows is untested.

entities.title: Local file systems only
entities.summary: The README lists local file systems as the only supported kind.
entities.impact: Roots on network file systems may miss change events.

entities.title: Symbolic links are not indexed
entities.summary: A path that is a symbolic link is skipped by reconcile and removed by analysis, even when git tracks it.
entities.impact: Files reached through a symlink are absent from find_files, outline, search and the other index-backed tools.

entities.title: Files over 16 MiB are listed but not analysed
entities.summary: A file larger than Engine.MaxIndexBytes gets a file record with blob id 0 and no analysis.
entities.impact: It appears in find_files and as "large file" in a directory outline, but has no symbols, identifiers or Bloom filter.
